inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL data-preparation query recursively scaffolds token positions, cross joins those positions to delimited text rows, and extracts each indexed word before producing a normalized row set.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a label-batch tokenizer. The recursive CTE derives the maximum token position from the new label rows, the cross join expands each row to its required positions, and nested SUBSTRING_INDEX calls extract the indexed token. This is the MariaDB/MySqweel equivalent of the source's occurrence-indexed REGEXP_SUBSTR; source tables, tweet data, temporary-table pipeline, and stopword workflow are not copied.

fixture_notes: Label batches contain three, two, and one comma-separated labels. The recursive scaffold expands exactly to the longest batch, and the position filter prevents fabricated tokens for shorter rows.
determinism_notes: Batch IDs, fixed label lists, recursive bound, extraction delimiter, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE label_batches (batch_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_list VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH RECURSIVE positions (position_no) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT position_no + 1 FROM positions WHERE position_no < (SELECT MAX(LENGTH(label_list) - LENGTH(REPLACE(label_list, ',', '')) + 1) FROM label_batches)) SELECT b.batch_id, p.position_no, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.label_list, ',', p.position_no), ',', -1) AS label_value FROM label_batches AS b CROSS JOIN positions AS p WHERE p.position_no <= LENGTH(b.label_list) - LENGTH(REPLACE(b.label_list, ',', '')) + 1 ORDER BY b.batch_id, p.position_no

WITH RECURSIVE positions (position_no) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT position_no + 1 FROM positions WHERE position_no < (SELECT MAX(LENGTH(label_list) - LENGTH(REPLACE(label_list, ',', '')) + 1) FROM label_batches)) SELECT b.batch_id, COUNT(*) AS label_count FROM label_batches AS b CROSS JOIN positions AS p WHERE p.position_no <= LENGTH(b.label_list) - LENGTH(REPLACE(b.label_list, ',', '')) + 1 GROUP BY b.batch_id ORDER BY b.batch_id

checks.sql: SELECT batch_id, label_list FROM label_batches ORDER BY batch_id
